title: Moravec policy submission manifest
description: Describes a policy container: how to start it and the observation/action interface it serves. Never contains credentials.

name.description: Your name for the policy: lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.

image.description: Container image. Submissions must pin it by digest: registry/repository@sha256:<64 hex>.

checkpoint.description: Path of the weights inside the image, or null for policies without weights.

command.description: Command that starts the policy server, as an argument list.

startup_timeout_s.description: Seconds allowed to load the model and open the port.

secrets.description: Names (never values) of environment variables the policy needs at run time.

image_shape.description: Height, width and channels of an RGB uint8 image.

robot.description: A robot key in utils/robot/_robot_info.json, which fixes the arm and gripper dimensions.

action_type.description: joint: {side}_arm_joint_state; ee: {side}_ee_pose as [x, y, z, qw, qx, qy, qz]. Both add {side}_ee_joint_state (gripper, 0 closed to 1 open).

cameras.description: Camera names the policy reads under obs['vision'], with their image shapes.

batching.description: Whether update_obs_batch and get_action_batch are supported.

instruction.description: Example task instruction used when testing the policy.

notes.description: The policy's own observation and action keys, units and chunk length.

check.description: Script, relative to the manifest, that tests a running server: it is called with --url and must exit 0 on success.
